notes: Modbus RTU on the RS-485 port, function 03 to read and 06 and 16 to write. Factory defaults from the register list: station address 1, 9600 baud, even parity (registers 6501 to 6503: baud 0 = 4800, 1 = 9600, 2 = 19200, 3 = 38400; parity 0 = even, 1 = odd, 2 = none).

Addresses are the register numbers of the register list, as printed (Modicon numbering, address base 1): the address on the wire is the register number minus 1. The register list does not state the base itself; this follows the same PM5000-family register list that other maps in this library use.

The register list is shared with the PM5000 family; only rows flagged for the EM7290 / 7280 / 7230 are included. The 'EM7280 (Ashoka) Customized registers' group is a customer-specific block that the list flags for these models.

Registers marked RWC in the register list can only be changed through the command interface (registers 5000 and following), so they are listed as read-only; the two password registers (write through a command only) are left out.

The register list does not state byte or word order; big-endian bytes with the most significant register first is assumed, as for the PM5000 family. A value the meter cannot provide reads as the N/A value of its data type (0xFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x8000 or a float NaN).

Registers described as FLOAT2 in the list (typo of a 32-bit float with a size of 2 registers) are read as float32. Registers whose unit is given as 'VA / W / A' in the list carry no unit here, because it depends on the demand channel.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
